facts.fact: Universal Ads offers self-serve streaming inventory with no campaign minimums, according to The Sasha Group.
facts.quote: Self-serve options with no campaign minimums like Universal Ads are making premium inventory on the TV screen even more accessible to brands of all sizes.

facts.fact: The Sasha Group said the Palmer's campaign scaled at a CPM much more efficient than originally anticipated, even with demo targeting.
facts.quote: Our campaign was able to scale at a very efficient CPM, much more efficient than we had originally anticipated even with demo targeting.

facts.fact: Universal Ads recently launched a partner program allowing brands to access creative capabilities from leading providers to build and test TV-ready commercials.
facts.quote: Universal Ads [recently launched](https://markets.ft.com/data/announce/detail?dockey=600-202506100801BIZWIRE_USPRX____20250610_BW711491-1) a partner program allowing brands to tap into creative capabilities

facts.fact: Palmer's said that based on historical results, TV tends to deliver a more immediate ROI.
facts.quote: Based on historical results, TV tends to deliver a more immediate ROI.
